Rider.description: A club member who rides. A first name alone is not an identity.

Route.description: A named club route, independent of who rides it.

Squad.description:
How one rider stands toward another: captained by, coached by or paced by them.
Pacing a rider is not coaching them.

Waymarking.description: Who marshals a route: the ride leader at the front or the sweeper at the back.

Outing.description: A club ride on a date. organiser arranged it, ride_leader rode at the front, first_aider carried the kit.

Repair.description: A fault on a rider's bike. owner rides the bike, mechanic works on it.

questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Route)-[:leader]->(n1:Rider) WHERE n0.route_title = 'Ridgeway Climb' RETURN n1.full_name AS full_name

questions.speaker: rhys
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Rider)-[:coach]->(n1:Rider) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.full_name AS full_name

questions.speaker: lalao
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Rider)-[:pupils]->(n1:Rider) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.full_name AS full_name

questions.speaker: haukur
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Rider)-[:swept]->(n1:Route) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.route_title AS route_title

questions.q: Did the hill reps need lights?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Outing) WHERE n0.headline = 'hill reps' RETURN n0.lights_required AS lights_required

questions.q: Is there a record of lights being required for the night ride?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Outing) WHERE n0.headline = 'night ride' RETURN coalesce(n0.lights_required, false) AS lights_required

questions.q: Which repairs has Haukur Magnusson worked on?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Rider)<-[:mechanic]-(n1:Repair) WHERE n0.full_name = 'Haukur Magnusson' RETURN n1.fault AS fault
MATCH (n0:Outing)-[:organiser]->(n1:Rider) WHERE n0.headline = 'night ride' RETURN n1.full_name AS full_name

questions.q: How much did the frame crack cost?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Repair) WHERE n0.fault = 'frame crack' RETURN n0.cost_euros AS cost_euros
MATCH (n0:Route)<-[:route]-(n1:Outing) WHERE n0.route_title = 'Harbour Flats' RETURN n1.headline AS headline
MATCH (n0:Rider)-[:captain]->(n1:Rider) WHERE n0.full_name = 'Nino Beridze' RETURN n1.full_name AS full_name

questions.q: What faults are recorded on my bikes?
questions.speaker: chidi
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Rider)<-[:owner]-(n1:Repair) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.fault AS fault
MATCH (n0:Outing) WHERE n0.headline CONTAINS 'ride' RETURN n0.headline AS headline

questions.q: What are the fault and state of every repair?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Repair) RETURN n0.fault AS fault, n0.state AS state

questions.q: Who is the sweeper on the Coal Valley Loop?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Route)-[:sweeper]->(n1:Rider) WHERE n0.route_title = 'Coal Valley Loop' RETURN n1.full_name AS full_name

questions.q: Was the snapped gear cable fixed under warranty?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Repair) WHERE n0.fault = 'snapped gear cable' RETURN n0.warranty AS warranty

questions.q: How far was the club run?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Outing) WHERE n0.headline = 'club run' RETURN n0.distance_km AS distance_km
